lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, with centroid coordinates forming roughly horizontal and vertical rows. Larger, higher-intensity clusters are concentrated in the mid-flank region above the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating a grid-like pattern particularly evident in the mid-lateral zone.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the dorsal-lateral interface, showing a sharp transition from a high-intensity upper margin to a shadowed lower margin, extending from the supra-branchial region posteriorly.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density distribution of significantly smaller, less-defined high-luminance points is visible across the cranial region and snout, transitioning into the larger, more structured grid pattern of the flank.
